name: VAT on construction services: two methods, two rates
name_zh: 建筑服务增值税：一般计税与简易计税
review_status: Drawn from the published national codes and from public statutory sources. Pending review by a Chinese cost engineer (造价工程师) before it is relied on for a tender.
references: 财税〔2016〕36号 营业税改征增值税试点实施办法
财政部 税务总局 海关总署公告2019年第39号
住建部办公厅〔2016〕4号 建筑业营改增计价依据调整
description: Construction moved from business tax to VAT in 2016, and the whole of the pricing base moved with it: a Chinese bill is priced tax-exclusive (除税价) and the tax is added as bill five. Which rate applies is not a property of the work but of the contract, and a contractor can be running both methods on different jobs at the same time.

methods.name: general method
methods.basis: output VAT on the tax-exclusive works cost, with input VAT credited

methods.name: simplified method
methods.basis: a collection rate on the tax-exclusive works cost, with no input credit
methods.applies_to: labour-only contracts (清包工), works where the employer supplies the materials (甲供工程), and old projects (老项目) whose permit or contract predates 2016-04-30, at the contractor's election

practice_notes: The 9 percent figure is the rate since 2019-04-01. It was 11 percent from 2016 and 10 percent from 2018-05-01, so an older bill is not wrong for carrying a different number
Tax-exclusive pricing means every rate in bills one to four already excludes VAT; applying the rate to a tax-inclusive base overstates the total
The election between methods is made per project and is not freely reversible
